summary: Join our Seed Technology and Business Management Training Course to master seed production techniques and learn essential business management skills.
lede: Seed technology and business management link seed production practices with quality assurance and commercial decision-making. Designed for seed producers, company staff, agribusiness owners, and agricultural program professionals, the course covers planning seed multiplication, checking germination and purity, maintaining traceability, managing production costs, and evaluating market demand and distribution.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in seed production, regulation, distribution, and agribusiness decision-making.
audience: Seed company managers and technical staff
Public sector agricultural and seed officers
NGO and donor-funded seed program managers
Input supply chain and distribution managers
Policy and regulatory stakeholders in agriculture
modules: Fundamentals of Seed Technology and Seed Systems
Seed Production Planning and Field Management
Seed Business Models and Cost Management
Sustainability and Innovation in the Seed Sector
Leadership and Strategic Decision-Making in Seed Enterprises
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of agricultural production systems and business management principles. Prior experience in seed-related roles is advantageous but not mandatory.
